import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd

# Configuration
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BATCH_SIZE = 8
EPOCHS = 50
IMG_DIR = "input/train"
CLEAN_DIR = "input/train_cleaned"
TEST_DIR = "input/test"


# Dataset loader
class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_files, clean_files):
        self.noisy_files = noisy_files
        self.clean_files = clean_files

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = (
            np.array(Image.open(self.noisy_files[idx]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
            / 255.0
        )
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


# Residual block network
class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.conv(x)


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.model = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            ResidualBlock(64),
            ResidualBlock(64),
            ResidualBlock(64),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.model(x)


# Prepare data
all_files = [os.path.join(IMG_DIR, f) for f in os.listdir(IMG_DIR)]
train_files, val_files = train_test_split(all_files, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
train_clean = [f.replace("train", "train_cleaned") for f in train_files]
val_clean = [f.replace("train", "train_cleaned") for f in val_files]

train_ds = DenoisingDataset(train_files, train_clean)
val_ds = DenoisingDataset(val_files, val_clean)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)

# Initialize model
model = Denoiser().to(device)
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Training loop
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for batch, (noisy, clean) in enumerate(train_loader):
        noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(noisy)
        loss = criterion(outputs, clean)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

# Validation
model.eval()
val_loss = 0.0
with torch.no_grad():
    for noisy, clean in val_loader:
        noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)

# Model Architecture
class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(UNet, self).__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(256, 512)

        # Decoder
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))

        # Bottleneck
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))

        # Decoder
        dec3 = self.up3(bn)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.up2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.up1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec1))

        i = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)

        if self.transform:

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),

        )

    def forward(self, x):

        self.bottleneck = self._block(256, 512)

        # Decoder
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))

        # Bottleneck
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))

        # Decoder
        dec3 = self.up3(bn)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.up2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.up1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec1))

            np.array(

            )
            / 255.0
        )

            np.array(

            )
            / 255.0
        )

    return noisy, clean

# Dataset with patch extraction and augmentation
class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20  # Multiple patches per image

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:

                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch)
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot)
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot)

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


# Model with depthwise separable convolutions and residuals
class DWSResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.dws = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.dws(x)


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)

            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),

        )

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder with skip connections
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)

        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20  # Multiple patches per image

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class DWSResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.dws = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.dws(x)


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, train=True):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(os.listdir(noisy_dir))
        self.clean_files = sorted(os.listdir(clean_dir))
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.train = train
        self.size = 512 if train else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.noisy_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.clean_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")

        if self.train:
            noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((512, 512))
            clean_img = clean_img.resize((512, 512))

            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                angle = torch.randint(-15, 15, (1,)).item()
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle)

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

train_size = int(0.8 * len(dataset))

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, train=True):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(os.listdir(noisy_dir))
        self.clean_files = sorted(os.listdir(clean_dir))
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.train = train
        self.size = 512 if train else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.noisy_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.clean_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")

        if self.train:
            # Initial resize
            noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((512, 512))
            clean_img = clean_img.resize((512, 512))

            # Horizontal flip
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

            # Rotation
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                angle = torch.randint(-15, 15, (1,)).item()
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)

            # Random affine transformations
            scale = 0.9 + 0.2 * torch.rand(1).item()  # 0.9-1.1
            shear_x = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            shear_y = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            translate_x = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()
            translate_y = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()

            noisy_img = affine(
                noisy_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                interpolation=Image.BILINEAR,
                fillcolor=255,
            )
            clean_img = affine(
                clean_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                interpolation=Image.BILINEAR,
                fillcolor=255,
            )

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_files, clean_files):
        self.noisy_files = noisy_files
        self.clean_files = clean_files

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(self.noisy_files[idx]).convert("L").resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        clean_img = Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).convert("L").resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        noisy = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32)[None] / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32)[None] / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy), torch.tensor(clean)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        x = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))

        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, e2], 1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, e1], 1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(x))

# Data preparation

def load_imgs(file_list):
    noisy, clean = [], []
    for f in file_list:
        noisy_img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(train_dir, f)).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean_img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(train_clean_dir, f)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        noisy.append(noisy_img)
        clean.append(clean_img)
    return noisy, clean


train_noisy, train_clean = load_imgs(train_files)
val_noisy, val_clean = load_imgs(val_files)


class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20  # Multiple patches per image

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch).copy()
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn = self.sigmoid(self.conv(x))
        return x * attn + x


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck with attention
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            AttentionBlock(256),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))

        # Decoder with attention
        d1 = self.up1(b)
        d1 = torch.cat([self.attn2(e2), d1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        d2 = self.up2(d1)
        d2 = torch.cat([self.attn1(e1), d2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        out = self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))
        return out


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = UNet().to(device)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-4)

from torchvision.transforms.functional import affine


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, train=True):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(os.listdir(noisy_dir))
        self.clean_files = sorted(os.listdir(clean_dir))
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.train = train
        self.size = 512 if train else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.noisy_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.clean_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")

        if self.train:
            # Initial resize
            noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((512, 512))
            clean_img = clean_img.resize((512, 512))

            # Horizontal flip
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

            # Rotation
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                angle = torch.randint(-15, 15, (1,)).item()
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)

            # Random affine transformations
            scale = 0.9 + 0.2 * torch.rand(1).item()  # 0.9-1.1
            shear_x = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            shear_y = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            translate_x = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()
            translate_y = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()

            noisy_img = affine(
                noisy_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                interpolation=Image.BILINEAR,
                fill=255,
            )
            clean_img = affine(
                clean_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                interpolation=Image.BILINEAR,
                fill=255,
            )

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(UNet, self).__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(256, 512)

        # Decoder
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))

        # Bottleneck
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))

        # Decoder
        dec3 = self.up3(bn)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.up2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.up1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec1))

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, patch_size=256, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.train = train

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames) * 10 if self.train else len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx // 10 if self.train else idx
        img_name = self.filenames[img_idx]
        noisy = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            i = (
                np.random.randint(0, H - self.patch_size + 1)
                if H > self.patch_size
                else 0
            )
            j = (
                np.random.randint(0, W - self.patch_size + 1)
                if W > self.patch_size
                else 0
            )
            noisy = noisy[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]

            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.fliplr(noisy).copy(), np.fliplr(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.flipud(noisy).copy(), np.flipud(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                k = np.random.choice([1, 2, 3])
                noisy, clean = np.rot90(noisy, k=k).copy(), np.rot90(clean, k=k).copy()
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            start_i = (H - self.patch_size) // 2
            start_j = (W - self.patch_size) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


class Autoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.decoder(self.encoder(x))


def process_image(model, img, patch_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = img.shape
    pad_h = (patch_size - (H % patch_size)) % patch_size
    pad_w = (patch_size - (W % patch_size)) % patch_size
    img_padded = np.pad(img, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")

    output = np.zeros_like(img_padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(img_padded)

    for i in range(0, img_padded.shape[0], stride):
        for j in range(0, img_padded.shape[1], stride):
            i_end = i + patch_size
            j_end = j + patch_size
            if i_end > img_padded.shape[0]:
                i = img_padded.shape[0] - patch_size
                i_end = img_padded.shape[0]
            if j_end > img_padded.shape[1]:
                j = img_padded.shape[1] - patch_size
                j_end = img_padded.shape[1]
            patch = img_padded[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            patch_tensor = torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred_patch = model(patch_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            output[i:i_end, j:j_end] += pred_patch
            count[i:i_end, j:j_end] += 1
    output = output / (count + 1e-7)
    return output[:H, :W]


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = Autoencoder().to(device)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)

filenames = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")])
train_files, val_files = random_split(

)

train_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
    noisy_dir, clean_dir, [filenames[i] for i in train_files.indices], train=True
)
val_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
    noisy_dir, clean_dir, [filenames[i] for i in val_files.indices], train=False
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=1, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(50):
    model.train()
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for img_name in [filenames[i] for i in val_files.indices]:
            noisy_img = (
                np.array(
                    Image.open(os.path.join(noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                    dtype=np.float32,
                )
                / 255.0
            )
            clean_img = (
                np.array(
                    Image.open(os.path.join(clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                    dtype=np.float32,
                )
                / 255.0
            )
            pred_img = process_image(model, noisy_img)
            val_loss += np.mean((pred_img - clean_img) ** 2) * noisy_img.size

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / sum(noisy_img.size for _ in val_files.indices))
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

        return len(self.noisy) * 20  # Multiple patches per image

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch).copy()
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn = self.sigmoid(self.conv(x))
        return x * attn + x


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck with attention
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            AttentionBlock(256),
        )

        # Decoder with bilinear upsampling
        self.up1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))

        # Decoder
        d1 = self.up1(b)
        d1 = torch.cat([self.attn2(e2), d1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        d2 = self.up2(d1)
        d2 = torch.cat([self.attn1(e1), d2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, features=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = self.block(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = self.block(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = self.block(features * 2, features * 4)

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder2 = self.block(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder1 = self.block(features * 2, features)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_channels, features):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, features, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(features),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(features, features, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(features),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        dec2 = self.upconv2(bottleneck)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)

        return self.activation(self.final(dec1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, patch_size=256, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.train = train

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames) * 10 if self.train else len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx // 10 if self.train else idx
        img_name = self.filenames[img_idx]
        noisy = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            i = (
                np.random.randint(0, H - self.patch_size + 1)
                if H > self.patch_size
                else 0
            )
            j = (
                np.random.randint(0, W - self.patch_size + 1)
                if W > self.patch_size
                else 0
            )
            noisy = noisy[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]

            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.fliplr(noisy), np.fliplr(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.flipud(noisy), np.flipud(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                k = np.random.choice([1, 2, 3])
                noisy, clean = np.rot90(noisy, k=k), np.rot90(clean, k=k)
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            start_i = (H - self.patch_size) // 2
            start_j = (W - self.patch_size) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


def process_image(model, img, patch_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = img.shape
    pad_h = (patch_size - (H % patch_size)) % patch_size
    pad_w = (patch_size - (W % patch_size)) % patch_size
    img_padded = np.pad(img, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")

    output = np.zeros_like(img_padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(img_padded)

    for i in range(0, img_padded.shape[0], stride):
        for j in range(0, img_padded.shape[1], stride):
            i_end = i + patch_size
            j_end = j + patch_size
            if i_end > img_padded.shape[0]:
                i = img_padded.shape[0] - patch_size
                i_end = img_padded.shape[0]
            if j_end > img_padded.shape[1]:
                j = img_padded.shape[1] - patch_size
                j_end = img_padded.shape[1]
            patch = img_padded[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            patch_tensor = torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred_patch = model(patch_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            output[i:i_end, j:j_end] += pred_patch
            count[i:i_end, j:j_end] += 1
    output = output / (count + 1e-7)
    return output[:H, :W]


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = UNet().to(device)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

for epoch in range(100):

        outputs = model(inputs)

    with torch.no_grad():

                np.array(

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(UNet, self).__init__()
        self.enc1 = self._block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = self._block(256, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))
        dec3 = self.dec3(torch.cat((self.up3(bn), enc3), 1))
        dec2 = self.dec2(torch.cat((self.up2(dec3), enc2), 1))
        dec1 = self.dec1(torch.cat((self.up1(dec2), enc1), 1))
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec1))

        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch).copy()
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))

        # Decoder
        d1 = self.up1(b)
        d1 = torch.cat([e2, d1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        d2 = self.up2(d1)
        d2 = torch.cat([e1, d2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, features=32):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = self.block(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = self.block(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = self.block(features * 2, features * 4)

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder2 = self.block(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder1 = self.block(features * 2, features)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_channels, features):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, features, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(features),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(features, features, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(features),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))
        dec2 = self.upconv2(bottleneck)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)
        return self.activation(self.final(dec1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, patch_size=256, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.train = train

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames) * 10 if self.train else len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx // 10 if self.train else idx
        img_name = self.filenames[img_idx]

        with Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)) as img:
            noisy = np.array(img.convert("L"), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        with Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)) as img:
            clean = np.array(img.convert("L"), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            i = np.random.randint(0, H - self.patch_size) if H > self.patch_size else 0
            j = np.random.randint(0, W - self.patch_size) if W > self.patch_size else 0
            noisy = noisy[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]

            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy = np.fliplr(noisy).copy()
                clean = np.fliplr(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy = np.flipud(noisy).copy()
                clean = np.flipud(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                k = np.random.choice([1, 2, 3])
                noisy = np.rot90(noisy, k=k).copy()
                clean = np.rot90(clean, k=k).copy()
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            start_i = (H - self.patch_size) // 2
            start_j = (W - self.patch_size) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


def process_image(model, img, patch_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = img.shape
    pad_h = (patch_size - (H % patch_size)) % patch_size
    pad_w = (patch_size - (W % patch_size)) % patch_size
    img_padded = np.pad(img, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")

    output = np.zeros_like(img_padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(img_padded)

    for i in range(0, img_padded.shape[0], stride):
        for j in range(0, img_padded.shape[1], stride):
            i_end = min(i + patch_size, img_padded.shape[0])
            j_end = min(j + patch_size, img_padded.shape[1])
            i_start = i_end - patch_size if i_end == img_padded.shape[0] else i
            j_start = j_end - patch_size if j_end == img_padded.shape[1] else j

            patch = img_padded[i_start:i_end, j_start:j_end]
            patch_tensor = torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred_patch = model(patch_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            output[i_start:i_end, j_start:j_end] += pred_patch
            count[i_start:i_end, j_start:j_end] += 1

    output = output / (count + 1e-7)
    return output[:H, :W]

from math import exp


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, self.channel)

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.Tensor(
            [
                exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2))
                for x in range(window_size)
            ]
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, channel):
        _1D_window = self.gaussian(window_size, 1.5).unsqueeze(1)
        _2D_window = _1D_window.mm(_1D_window.t()).float().unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        return _2D_window.expand(channel, 1, window_size, window_size).contiguous()

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        (_, channel, _, _) = img1.size()
        window = self.window.to(img1.device, dtype=img1.dtype)

        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = (0.01 * 1) ** 2  # Assuming pixel values are normalized to [0,1]
        C2 = (0.03 * 1) ** 2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    # Keep existing dataset implementation unchanged
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, train=True):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(os.listdir(noisy_dir))

        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.train = train
        self.size = 512 if train else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.noisy_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.clean_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")

        if self.train:
            noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((512, 512))
            clean_img = clean_img.resize((512, 512))

            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                angle = torch.randint(-15, 15, (1,)).item()
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle, fillcolor=255)

            scale = 0.9 + 0.2 * torch.rand(1).item()
            shear_x = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            shear_y = torch.randint(-10, 10, (1,)).item()
            translate_x = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()
            translate_y = torch.randint(-20, 20, (1,)).item()

            noisy_img = affine(
                noisy_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                fill=255,
            )
            clean_img = affine(
                clean_img,
                angle=0,
                translate=(translate_x, translate_y),
                scale=scale,
                shear=(shear_x, shear_y),
                fill=255,
            )

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
        )


# Keep existing UNet architecture unchanged
class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.W_x = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g_conv = self.W_g(g)
        x_conv = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g_conv + x_conv)
        attention = self.psi(psi)
        return x * attention


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))

        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)

        x = self.upconv1(x)
        enc2 = self.attn1(x, enc2)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)

        x = self.upconv2(x)
        enc1 = self.attn2(x, enc1)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

        d2 = self.dec2(d2)  # [B,64,H,W]

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(UNet, self).__init__()
        self.enc1 = self._block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self._block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self._block(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = self._block(256, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def _block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool(enc2))
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool(enc3))
        dec3 = self.dec3(torch.cat((self.up3(bn), enc3), 1))
        dec2 = self.dec2(torch.cat((self.up2(dec3), enc2), 1))
        dec1 = self.dec1(torch.cat((self.up1(dec2), enc1), 1))
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec1))

# Define UNet with attention and residual blocks
class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.W_x = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g_conv = self.W_g(g)
        x_conv = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g_conv + x_conv)
        attention = self.psi(psi)
        return x * attention


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))

        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)

        x = self.upconv1(x)
        enc2 = self.attn1(x, enc2)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)

        x = self.upconv2(x)
        enc1 = self.attn2(x, enc1)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, img_dir, clean_dir, transform=False):
        self.img_dir = img_dir

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        return self.relu(out + residual)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(b), e2], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d1), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))

class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.W_x = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g_conv = self.W_g(g)
        x_conv = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g_conv + x_conv)
        attention = self.psi(psi)
        return x * attention


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(1, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(64, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 256), ResBlock(256, 256))

        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(256, 128), ResBlock(128, 128))

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(128, 64), ResBlock(64, 64))

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)
        x = self.bottleneck(x)

        x = self.upconv1(x)
        enc2 = self.attn1(x, enc2)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)

        x = self.upconv2(x)
        enc1 = self.attn2(x, enc1)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
