class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channel, reduction=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1, 1)
        return x * y.expand_as(x)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.LeakyReLU(0.2, inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.se = SEBlock(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out = self.se(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        return self.relu(out + identity)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        features = 128
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(1, features), ResidualBlock(features, features)
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features, features * 2),
            ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 2),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 4),
            ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 4),
        )
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 8),
            ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 8),
        )
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 4),
            ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 4),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 2),
            ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 2),
        )
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(features * 2, features), ResidualBlock(features, features)
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(features, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        bn = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(bn), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.se = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(in_channels, in_channels // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(in_channels // reduction, in_channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
            nn.Unflatten(1, (in_channels, 1, 1)),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        res = self.conv(x)
        se_weights = self.se(res)
        res = res * se_weights
        return x + res


class EnhancedUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU())

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU())

        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))
        d1 = self.dec1(self.up1(b) + e2)
        d2 = self.dec2(self.up2(d1) + e1)
        return self.final(d2)

class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.channel_att = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_att = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        channel = self.channel_att(x) * x
        max_pool = torch.max(channel, 1, keepdim=True)[0]
        avg_pool = torch.mean(channel, 1, keepdim=True)
        spatial = self.spatial_att(torch.cat([max_pool, avg_pool], 1)) * channel
        return spatial


class AttentiveUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(64),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(128),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(256),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(128),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(64),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(enc2)
        bottle = self.bottleneck(p2)

        up1 = self.up1(bottle)
        up1 = torch.cat([up1, enc2], 1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(up1)

        up2 = self.up2(dec1)
        up2 = torch.cat([up2, enc1], 1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(up2)

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(dec2))

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.test_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        orig_w, orig_h = img.size
        img = np.array(img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(image=img)["image"]

        return torch.from_numpy(img).unsqueeze(0), filename, (orig_w, orig_h)


class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.channel_att = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_att = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        channel = self.channel_att(x) * x
        max_pool = torch.max(channel, 1, keepdim=True)[0]
        avg_pool = torch.mean(channel, 1, keepdim=True)
        spatial = self.spatial_att(torch.cat([max_pool, avg_pool], 1)) * channel
        return spatial


class AttentiveUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(64),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(128),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(256),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(128),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            CBAM(64),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(enc2)
        bottle = self.bottleneck(p2)

        up1 = self.up1(bottle)
        up1 = torch.cat([up1, enc2], 1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(up1)

        up2 = self.up2(dec1)
        up2 = torch.cat([up2, enc1], 1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(up2)

        return self.final(dec2)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):

        clean_img = Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).convert("L")

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self.block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self.block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self.block(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = self.block(256, 512)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bneck = self.block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, 2, 2)
        self.dec4 = self.block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self.block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self.block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self.block(128, 64)

        self.out = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bneck(self.pool(e4))

        # Decoder with skip connections
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([e4, self.up4(b)], 1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([e3, self.up3(d4)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([e2, self.up2(d3)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([e1, self.up1(d2)], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.out(d1))

class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.channel_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1, bias=False),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, 1, 7, padding=3, bias=False), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        ca = self.channel_attention(x)
        x = x * ca
        sa = self.spatial_attention(x)
        return x * sa


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.cbam = CBAM(in_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        res = self.conv(x)
        res = self.cbam(res)
        return x + res


class EnhancedUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU())

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU())

        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))
        d1 = self.dec1(self.up1(b) + e2)
        d2 = self.dec2(self.up2(d1) + e1)
        return self.final(d2)

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
import glob
import pandas as pd


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, patch_size=256, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.train = train

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames) * 10 if self.train else len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx // 10 if self.train else idx
        img_name = self.filenames[img_idx]

        noisy = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            i = np.random.randint(0, H - self.patch_size) if H > self.patch_size else 0
            j = np.random.randint(0, W - self.patch_size) if W > self.patch_size else 0
            noisy = noisy[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + self.patch_size, j : j + self.patch_size]

            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.fliplr(noisy), np.fliplr(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.flipud(noisy), np.flipud(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.rot90(noisy), np.rot90(clean)
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            start_i = (H - self.patch_size) // 2
            start_j = (W - self.patch_size) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


class Autoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.decoder(self.encoder(x))


def sliding_inference(model, image, window_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = image.shape
    pad_h = (window_size - (H % window_size)) % window_size
    pad_w = (window_size - (W % window_size)) % window_size
    padded = np.pad(image, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")
    output = np.zeros_like(padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(padded)

    for y in range(0, padded.shape[0] - window_size + 1, stride):
        for x in range(0, padded.shape[1] - window_size + 1, stride):
            patch = padded[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size]
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred = (
                    model(torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).cuda())
                    .squeeze()
                    .cpu()
                    .numpy()
                )
            output[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += pred
            count[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += 1

    return (output / count)[:H, :W]


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = Autoencoder().to(device)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)

# Data preparation
noisy_dir = "input/train"
clean_dir = "input/train_cleaned"
filenames = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")])
train_files, val_files = random_split(

)

train_dataset = DenoisingDataset(

)
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)

# Training loop
best_val_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(50):
    model.train()
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

# Full-image validation
model.eval()
val_rmse = 0.0
for filename in [filenames[i] for i in val_files.indices]:
    noisy = (
        np.array(Image.open(f"input/train/{filename}").convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
        / 255.0
    )
    clean = (
        np.array(
            Image.open(f"input/train_cleaned/{filename}").convert("L"), dtype=np.float32
        )
        / 255.0
    )
    pred = sliding_inference(model, noisy)
    val_rmse += np.mean((pred - clean) ** 2) * clean.size

val_rmse = np.sqrt(
    val_rmse
    / sum(
        [
            np.array(Image.open(f"input/train_cleaned/{f}")).size
            for f in [filenames[i] for i in val_files.indices]
        ]
    )
)
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Generate submission
submission = []

class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self.block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self.block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self.block(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = self.block(256, 512)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bneck = self.block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder with bilinear upsampling
        self.up4 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(1024, 512, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec4 = self.block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 256, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec3 = self.block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec2 = self.block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.dec1 = self.block(128, 64)

        self.out = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))

        b = self.bneck(self.pool(e4))

        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([e4, self.up4(b)], 1))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([e3, self.up3(d4)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([e2, self.up2(d3)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([e1, self.up1(d2)], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.out(d1))

from torchvision import transforms as T

class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.gauss_kernel = self.create_gaussian_kernel(window_size, sigma)

    def create_gaussian_kernel(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size).float() - window_size // 2
        gauss = torch.exp(-x.pow(2) / (2 * sigma**2))
        gauss /= gauss.sum()
        kernel = gauss.ger(gauss).view(1, 1, window_size, window_size)
        return kernel.requires_grad_(False)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        if img1.size(1) > 1:  # Handle grayscale images
            img1 = img1.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
            img2 = img2.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)

        # Ensure kernel is on correct device
        self.gauss_kernel = self.gauss_kernel.to(img1.device)

        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, self.gauss_kernel, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, self.gauss_kernel, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                img1 * img1, self.gauss_kernel, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1
            )
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                img2 * img2, self.gauss_kernel, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1
            )
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(
                img1 * img2, self.gauss_kernel, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1
            )
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.channel_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1, bias=False),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, 1, 7, padding=3, bias=False), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        ca = self.channel_attention(x)
        x = x * ca
        sa = self.spatial_attention(x)
        return x * sa


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.cbam = CBAM(in_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        res = self.conv(x)
        res = self.cbam(res)
        return x + res


class EnhancedUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(128), nn.ReLU())

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(ResidualBlock(64), nn.ReLU())

        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))
        d1 = self.dec1(self.up1(b) + e2)
        d2 = self.dec2(self.up2(d1) + e1)
        return self.final(d2)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, files=None, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.files = (
            [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]
            if files is None
            else files
        )
        self.train = train
        self.base_transform = T.Compose([T.Resize((420, 540)), T.ToTensor()])
        self.augment = T.Compose(
            [
                T.RandomHorizontalFlip(0.5),
                T.RandomVerticalFlip(0.2),
                T.RandomApply([T.GaussianBlur(3, (0.1, 2))], 0.3),
                T.RandomAdjustSharpness(2, 0.3),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.files[idx])).convert("L")
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.files[idx])).convert("L")

        noisy = self.base_transform(noisy)
        clean = self.base_transform(clean)

        if self.train:
            state = torch.random.get_rng_state()
            noisy = self.augment(noisy)
            torch.set_rng_state(state)
            clean = self.augment(clean)

        return noisy, clean


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = EnhancedUNet().to(device)
criterion_l1 = nn.L1Loss()
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss()

all_files = [f for f in os.listdir("input/train") if f.endswith(".png")]

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(100):

    for noisy, clean in train_loader:
        noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(noisy)
        loss = 0.5 * criterion_l1(outputs, clean) + 0.5 * criterion_ssim(outputs, clean)

    val_loss = 0

        for noisy, clean in val_loader:
            noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
            outputs = model(noisy)
            val_loss += F.mse_loss(outputs, clean).item()

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_loader))
    scheduler.step(val_rmse)

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:

class UNet(nn.Module):

        self.enc2 = self.block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self.block(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = self.block(256, 512)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bneck = self.block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder with transposed convolutions
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self.block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self.block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self.block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self.block(128, 64)

        self.out = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bneck(self.pool(e4))

        # Decoder with cropping
        up4 = self.up4(b)
        diffY = e4.size()[2] - up4.size()[2]
        diffX = e4.size()[3] - up4.size()[3]
        e4 = e4[

            diffY // 2 : e4.size()[2] - diffY // 2 - (diffY % 2),
            diffX // 2 : e4.size()[3] - diffX // 2 - (diffX % 2),
        ]
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([e4, up4], 1))

        up3 = self.up3(d4)
        diffY = e3.size()[2] - up3.size()[2]
        diffX = e3.size()[3] - up3.size()[3]
        e3 = e3[
            :,
            :,
            diffY // 2 : e3.size()[2] - diffY // 2 - (diffY % 2),
            diffX // 2 : e3.size()[3] - diffX // 2 - (diffX % 2),
        ]
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([e3, up3], 1))

        up2 = self.up2(d3)
        diffY = e2.size()[2] - up2.size()[2]
        diffX = e2.size()[3] - up2.size()[3]
        e2 = e2[
            :,
            :,
            diffY // 2 : e2.size()[2] - diffY // 2 - (diffY % 2),
            diffX // 2 : e2.size()[3] - diffX // 2 - (diffX % 2),
        ]
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([e2, up2], 1))

        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        diffY = e1.size()[2] - up1.size()[2]
        diffX = e1.size()[3] - up1.size()[3]
        e1 = e1[

            :,
            diffY // 2 : e1.size()[2] - diffY // 2 - (diffY % 2),
            diffX // 2 : e1.size()[3] - diffX // 2 - (diffX % 2),
        ]
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([e1, up1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.out(d1))

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):

            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            # Ensure patch_size doesn't exceed image dimensions
            patch_size = min(self.patch_size, H, W)
            i = np.random.randint(0, H - patch_size) if H > patch_size else 0
            j = np.random.randint(0, W - patch_size) if W > patch_size else 0
            noisy = noisy[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

            # Apply augmentations
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy = np.fliplr(noisy).copy()  # Add copy to make array contiguous
                clean = np.fliplr(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy = np.flipud(noisy).copy()
                clean = np.flipud(clean).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                rot = np.random.choice([1, 3])
                noisy = np.rot90(noisy, rot).copy()
                clean = np.rot90(clean, rot).copy()
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            patch_size = min(self.patch_size, H, W)
            start_i = (H - patch_size) // 2
            start_j = (W - patch_size) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + patch_size, start_j : start_j + patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + patch_size, start_j : start_j + patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy.copy()).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(
            clean.copy()
        ).unsqueeze(0)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        dec1 = self.upconv1(enc2)
        dec1 = torch.cat([dec1, enc1], dim=1)
        return self.decoder1(dec1)


def sliding_inference(model, image, window_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = image.shape
    pad_h = (window_size - (H % window_size)) % window_size
    pad_w = (window_size - (W % window_size)) % window_size
    padded = np.pad(image, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")
    output = np.zeros_like(padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(padded)

    for y in range(0, padded.shape[0] - window_size + 1, stride):
        for x in range(0, padded.shape[1] - window_size + 1, stride):
            patch = padded[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size]
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred = model(torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).cuda())
                pred = pred.squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            output[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += pred
            count[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += 1

    return (output / count)[:H, :W]

def load_imgs(file_list):
    noisy, clean = [], []
    for f in file_list:
        noisy_img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(train_dir, f)).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        )

    return noisy, clean


train_noisy, train_clean = load_imgs(train_files)

class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch).copy()
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.C1 = (0.01) ** 2
        self.C2 = (0.03) ** 2

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        ax = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        xx, yy = torch.meshgrid(ax, ax, indexing="ij")
        kernel = torch.exp(-(xx**2 + yy**2) / (2 * sigma**2))
        kernel /= kernel.sum()
        return kernel.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2
        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_mu2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + self.C1) * (2 * sigma12 + self.C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + self.C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + self.C2) + 1e-6
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DWSResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.dws = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.dws(x)


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = Denoiser().to(device)
criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss()
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=3)

train_dataset = DocDataset(train_noisy, train_clean)
val_dataset = DocDataset(val_noisy, val_clean, train=False)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=4)

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for n, c in train_loader:

        optimizer.zero_grad()

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        x = self.conv(x)
        x += residual
        return self.relu(x)


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(512),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(256)
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 128, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(128)
        )
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 64, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(64)
        )

        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(e1)
        e3 = self.enc3(e2)

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bottleneck(e3)

        # Decoder with skip connections
        d3 = self.dec3(b)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], dim=1)

        d2 = self.dec2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], dim=1)

        d1 = self.dec1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], dim=1)

        return self.final(d1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):

import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BATCH_SIZE = 4
EPOCHS = 30
IMG_DIR = "input/train"
CLEAN_DIR = "input/train_cleaned"
TEST_DIR = "input/test"


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_files, clean_files):
        self.noisy_files = noisy_files
        self.clean_files = clean_files

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(self.noisy_files[idx]).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).convert("L")
        noisy = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0

        # Pad images to multiples of 16
        h, w = noisy.shape
        pad_h = (16 - h % 16) % 16
        pad_w = (16 - w % 16) % 16
        noisy_padded = np.pad(noisy, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")
        clean_padded = np.pad(clean, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")

        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy_padded[None]),  # Add channel dimension
            torch.tensor(clean_padded[None]),
        )


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self.block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = self.block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self.block(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = self.block(256, 512)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bneck = self.block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder
        self.up4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(1024, 512, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec4 = self.block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = self.block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = self.block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self.block(128, 64)

        self.out = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bneck(self.pool(e4))

        # Decoder with cropping
        up4 = self.up4(b)
        d4 = self.dec4(torch.cat([e4, up4], 1))
        up3 = self.up3(d4)
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([e3, up3], 1))
        up2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([e2, up2], 1))
        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([e1, up1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.out(d1))


# Data preparation
all_files = [os.path.join(IMG_DIR, f) for f in os.listdir(IMG_DIR)]
train_files, val_files = train_test_split(all_files, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
train_clean = [f.replace("train", "train_cleaned") for f in train_files]
val_clean = [f.replace("train", "train_cleaned") for f in val_files]

train_ds = DenoisingDataset(train_files, train_clean)
val_ds = DenoisingDataset(val_files, val_clean)
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

model = UNet().to(device)
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Training loop
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for noisy, clean in train_loader:
        noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(noisy)
        loss = criterion(outputs, clean)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

# Validation
model.eval()
val_loss = 0.0
with torch.no_grad():
    for noisy, clean in val_loader:
        noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
        outputs = model(noisy)
        val_loss += criterion(outputs, clean).item() * noisy.size(0)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_ds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Generate submission
test_files = [os.path.join(TEST_DIR, f) for f in os.listdir(TEST_DIR)]
submission = []
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    for file in test_files:
        img = Image.open(file).convert("L")
        img_np = np.array(img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        h, w = img_np.shape

        # Pad the image
        pad_h = (16 - h % 16) % 16
        pad_w = (16 - w % 16) % 16
        img_padded = np.pad(img_np, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")
        tensor = torch.tensor(img_padded[None, None]).to(device)

        pred_padded = model(tensor)
        pred = pred_padded[0, 0, :h, :w].cpu().numpy()

        base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(file))[0]
        rows, cols = np.indices((h, w)) + 1
        ids = [f"{base}_{r}_{c}" for r, c in zip(rows.flatten(), cols.flatten())]
        values = pred.flatten()
        submission.extend(zip(ids, values))

# Save submission
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"]).to_csv(
    "submission/submission.csv", index=False
)
import os

# Data preparation
train_dir = "input/train"
train_clean_dir = "input/train_cleaned"
test_dir = "input/test"

filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(train_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]
train_files, val_files = train_test_split(filenames, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)


def load_imgs(file_list):
    noisy, clean = [], []
    for f in file_list:
        noisy_img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(train_dir, f)).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean_img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(train_clean_dir, f)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        noisy.append(noisy_img)
        clean.append(clean_img)
    return noisy, clean


train_noisy, train_clean = load_imgs(train_files)
val_noisy, val_clean = load_imgs(val_files)


class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()
                c_patch = np.flipud(c_patch).copy()
            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.C1 = (0.01) ** 2
        self.C2 = (0.03) ** 2

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        ax = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        xx, yy = torch.meshgrid(ax, ax, indexing="ij")
        kernel = torch.exp(-(xx**2 + yy**2) / (2 * sigma**2))
        kernel /= kernel.sum()
        return kernel.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2
        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_mu2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + self.C1) * (2 * sigma12 + self.C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + self.C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + self.C2) + 1e-6
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DWSResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.dws = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
        )
        self.se = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch // reduction, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch // reduction, ch, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        res = self.dws(x)
        se = self.se(res)
        return x + res * se


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = Denoiser().to(device)
criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss()
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=3)

train_dataset = DocDataset(train_noisy, train_clean)
val_dataset = DocDataset(val_noisy, val_clean, train=False)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=4)

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for n, c in train_loader:
        n, c = n.to(device), c.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(n)
        mse = criterion_mse(pred, c)
        ssim = criterion_ssim(pred, c)
        loss = 0.85 * mse + 0.15 * ssim
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += mse.item() * n.size(0)
    train_loss /= len(train_dataset)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for n, c in val_loader:
            pred = model(n.to(device))
            val_loss += criterion_mse(pred, c.to(device)).item() * n.size(0)
    val_loss /= len(val_dataset)
    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
    scheduler.step(val_loss)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.4f}")

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

submission = []
for test_file in os.listdir(test_dir):
    if test_file.endswith(".png"):
        img_id = test_file.split(".")[0]
        img = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(test_dir, test_file)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        h, w = img.shape

        with torch.no_grad():
            input_tensor = torch.tensor(img).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
            pred = model(input_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

        rows, cols = np.indices((h, w))
        pixel_ids = [
            f"{img_id}_{r+1}_{c+1}" for r, c in zip(rows.flatten(), cols.flatten())
        ]
        values = pred.flatten()
        submission.extend(zip(pixel_ids, values))

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import glob
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.relu(x + self.conv(x))


class DeepUNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(128),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(256),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
        )

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(512),
        )

        # Decoder with corrected channels
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(256)
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(384, 128, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(128)  # 256+128
        )
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(192, 64, 2, stride=2), ResidualBlock(64)  # 128+64
        )
        self.final = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(e1)
        e3 = self.enc3(e2)

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bottleneck(e3)

        # Decoder with corrected skip connections
        d3 = self.dec3(b)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e2], dim=1)

        d2 = self.dec2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e1], dim=1)

        d1 = self.dec1(d2)
        return self.final(d1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, patch_size=256, train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.train = train

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames) * 20

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.filenames)
        img_name = self.filenames[img_idx]

        noisy = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )
        clean = (
            np.array(
                Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, img_name)).convert("L"),
                dtype=np.float32,
            )
            / 255.0
        )

        if self.train:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            patch_size = min(self.patch_size, H, W)
            i = np.random.randint(0, H - patch_size) if H > patch_size else 0
            j = np.random.randint(0, W - patch_size) if W > patch_size else 0
            noisy = noisy[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]
            clean = clean[i : i + patch_size, j : j + patch_size]

            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.fliplr(noisy), np.fliplr(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                noisy, clean = np.flipud(noisy), np.flipud(clean)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                rot = np.random.choice([1, 3])
                noisy, clean = np.rot90(noisy, rot), np.rot90(clean, rot)
        else:
            H, W = noisy.shape
            start_i = (H - min(H, self.patch_size)) // 2
            start_j = (W - min(W, self.patch_size)) // 2
            noisy = noisy[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]
            clean = clean[
                start_i : start_i + self.patch_size, start_j : start_j + self.patch_size
            ]

        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


def sliding_inference(model, image, window_size=256, stride=128):
    H, W = image.shape
    pad_h = (window_size - (H % window_size)) % window_size
    pad_w = (window_size - (W % window_size)) % window_size
    padded = np.pad(image, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), mode="reflect")
    output = np.zeros_like(padded)
    count = np.zeros_like(padded)

    for y in range(0, padded.shape[0] - window_size + 1, stride):
        for x in range(0, padded.shape[1] - window_size + 1, stride):
            patch = padded[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size]
            with torch.no_grad():
                pred = model(torch.tensor(patch).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).cuda())
                pred = pred.squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            output[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += pred
            count[y : y + window_size, x : x + window_size] += 1

    return (output / count)[:H, :W]


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = DeepUNet().to(device)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", patience=3, factor=0.5
)

# Data setup
noisy_dir = "input/train"
clean_dir = "input/train_cleaned"
filenames = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")])
train_files, val_files = train_test_split(filenames, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

train_dataset = DenoisingDataset(noisy_dir, clean_dir, train_files)
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)
val_dataset = DenoisingDataset(noisy_dir, clean_dir, val_files, train=False)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=8, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

best_val_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(50):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for inputs, targets in val_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_dataset))
    scheduler.step(val_rmse)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_val_rmse:
        best_val_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

submission = []
for test_path in sorted(glob.glob("input/test/*.png")):
    filename = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(test_path))[0]
    img = np.array(Image.open(test_path).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    pred = sliding_inference(model, img)

    rows, cols = pred.shape
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            submission.append([f"{filename}_{r+1}_{c+1}", pred[r, c]])

pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"]).to_csv(
    "submission/submission.csv", index=False
)

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageOps
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1  # Grayscale images

        # Create Gaussian window
        gauss = torch.Tensor(
            [
                np.exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2))
                for x in range(window_size)
            ]
        )
        gauss = gauss / gauss.sum()
        window = gauss.unsqueeze(1) * gauss.unsqueeze(0)
        self.register_buffer("window", window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0))

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            pred, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_target = F.conv2d(
            target, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )

        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_target_sq = mu_target.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_target = mu_pred * mu_target

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                pred * pred,
                self.window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_target_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                target * target,
                self.window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_target_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_target = (
            F.conv2d(
                pred * target,
                self.window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_target
        )

        C1 = (0.01 * 1) ** 2  # Since data range is 0-1
        C2 = (0.03 * 1) ** 2

        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_target + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_target + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_target_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_target_sq + C2)
        )

        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, train=True):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(os.listdir(noisy_dir))
        self.clean_files = sorted(os.listdir(clean_dir))
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.train = train
        self.size = 512 if train else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.noisy_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(
            os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.clean_files[idx])
        ).convert("L")

        if self.train:
            # Resize and augment
            noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((512, 512))
            clean_img = clean_img.resize((512, 512))

            # Random horizontal flip
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

            # Random rotation
            if torch.rand(1) > 0.5:
                angle = torch.randint(-15, 15, (1,)).item()
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle)

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # Decoder with skip connections
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        x = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.enc2(x)
        x = self.pool2(enc2)

        # Bottleneck
        x = self.bottleneck(x)

        # Decoder
        x = self.upconv1(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc2], dim=1)
        x = self.dec1(x)
        x = self.upconv2(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, enc1], dim=1)
        x = self.dec2(x)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final_conv(x))

class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        h, w = n_img.shape
        if self.train:
            top = np.random.randint(0, h - self.ps)
            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:

                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch).copy()
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.flipud(n_patch).copy()

            rot = np.random.choice(4)
            n_patch = np.rot90(n_patch, rot).copy()
            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot).copy()

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.C1 = (0.01) ** 2
        self.C2 = (0.03) ** 2

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        ax = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        xx, yy = torch.meshgrid(ax, ax, indexing="ij")
        kernel = torch.exp(-(xx**2 + yy**2) / (2 * sigma**2))
        kernel /= kernel.sum()
        return kernel.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2)
        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2
        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2) - mu1_mu2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + self.C1) * (2 * sigma12 + self.C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + self.C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + self.C2) + 1e-6
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class GradientDifferenceLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.sobel_x = nn.Conv2d(1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.sobel_x.weight.data = torch.tensor(
            [[[[-1, 0, 1], [-2, 0, 2], [-1, 0, 1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        self.sobel_y = nn.Conv2d(1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.sobel_y.weight.data = torch.tensor(
            [[[[1, 2, 1], [0, 0, 0], [-1, -2, -1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        pred_grad_x = self.sobel_x(pred)
        pred_grad_y = self.sobel_y(pred)
        target_grad_x = self.sobel_x(target)
        target_grad_y = self.sobel_y(target)
        loss = self.mse(pred_grad_x, target_grad_x) + self.mse(
            pred_grad_y, target_grad_y
        )
        return loss


class DWSResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, ch, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.dws = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 3, padding=1, groups=ch),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1),
        )
        self.se = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch // reduction, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(ch // reduction, ch, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        res = self.dws(x)
        se = self.se(res)
        return x + res * se


class Denoiser(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            DWSResBlock(32),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = Denoiser().to(device)
criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss()
criterion_grad = GradientDifferenceLoss().to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=3)

train_dataset = DocDataset(train_noisy, train_clean)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=4)

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:

def load_imgs(file_list):

class DocDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy, clean, train=True, patch_size=256):
        self.noisy = noisy
        self.clean = clean
        self.train = train
        self.ps = patch_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomAffine(
                        degrees=15, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.9, 1.1)
                    ),
                ]
            )
            if train
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy) * 20

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_idx = idx % len(self.noisy)
        n_img = self.noisy[img_idx]
        c_img = self.clean[img_idx]

        if self.train:

            left = np.random.randint(0, w - self.ps)
        else:
            top = (h - self.ps) // 2
            left = (w - self.ps) // 2

        n_patch = n_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]
        c_patch = c_img[top : top + self.ps, left : left + self.ps]

        if self.train:
            # Apply affine transform
            stacked = np.stack([n_patch, c_patch], axis=0)
            stacked = self.transform(torch.tensor(stacked)).numpy()
            n_patch, c_patch = stacked[0], stacked[1]

            # Add Gaussian noise
            noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.05, n_patch.shape)
            n_patch = np.clip(n_patch + noise, 0, 1)

            # Random flips/rotations
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:
                n_patch = np.fliplr(n_patch)
                c_patch = np.fliplr(c_patch)
            if np.random.rand() > 0.5:

            c_patch = np.rot90(c_patch, rot)

        return torch.tensor(n_patch).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(c_patch).unsqueeze(0)


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class ResidualConvBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.relu(x + self.conv(x))


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualConvBlock(64))
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualConvBlock(128)
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.MaxPool2d(2), nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualConvBlock(256)
        )
        self.center = nn.Sequential(
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            ResidualConvBlock(256),
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 256, 2, stride=2),
        )
        self.att3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualConvBlock(512), nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 128, 2, stride=2)
        )
        self.att2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(

        d2 = self.att2(d3, e2)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, d3], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        d1 = self.att1(d2, e1)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, d2], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)
        out = self.final(d1)
        return self.sigmoid(out)
